renderings.value: Since primary school we've been checking for the qualities known as acidity and alkalinity with litmus paper.
When investigating the pH (acidic, neutral, alkaline) of a liquid, don't soak the litmus paper completely in the liquid but just put the end of the paper in it.
Acid fruits like pineapples and lemons are sour.
The ocean is becoming more acidic.
When the ocean absorbs a lot of CO₂, the water becomes more acidic.
